_synthetic: Example payload from Horizon's own OpenAPI spec for POST /transactions_async (txsub_async_oapi.yaml, HTTP 500 'Transaction Submission Failed' example), fetched during Milestone 4's audit. Represents a Horizon-to-Core communication failure — Horizon itself does not know whether stellar-core received the transaction — not a stellar-core submission-outcome classification. normalizeHorizonTransaction() deliberately does not model this as a transaction state.
title: Transaction Submission Failed
detail: Could not submit transaction to stellar-core. The `extras.error` field on this response contains further details.
